versions.subject: Rule: RDP over Reverse SSH Tunnel
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 3
    Image: '*\svchost.exe'
    SourcePort: 3389 
    DestinationIp:
        - '127.*'
        - '::1'
condition: selection
